question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Anticipate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Predict**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Anticipate"** means to expect or predict something that might happen in the future. (पूर्वानुमान करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The weather forecast allows us to anticipate heavy rains tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **"Predict"** refers to stating or estimating that a specific event will happen in the future based on knowledge or reasoning. (भविष्यवाणी करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists predict that the global temperature will rise significantly in the next century.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word **"Predict"** is the most appropriate synonym of "Anticipate".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Predict**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accuse** (आरोप लगाना): To charge someone with an offense or wrongdoing.

 
 
• **Example:** She accused him of stealing her wallet.
 
 
 
• **Doubt** (संदेह करना): To feel uncertain or lack confidence about something.
 
 
• **Example:** I doubt that he will arrive on time given the traffic situation.
 
 
 
• **Conceal** (छुपाना): To hide or keep something secret.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to conceal his nervousness during the interview.
